The '''Fourth battalion''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] organized under the [[35th Infantry]] [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]]. The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] battalion served during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and saw [[Battle of Gaftikar|action]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaftikar]].<ref name="RC:TC" />
